newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Clinton envoy in Morocco to see Arafat.
newsitem.headline: Clinton envoy in Morocco to see Arafat.

text.p: U.S. Middle East envoy Dennis Ross arrived in Morocco on Wednesday evening for a meeting with Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat on his way to Israel.

Ross has been sent by President Bill Clinton to try to break a deadlock in Israeli-Palestinian peacemaking. His arrival was reported by the Moroccan Ministry of Communications. Reporters were not allowed into the military airport where his plane landed.
Arafat, who has been on a visit to Bangladesh, was expected in the Moroccan capital at around 4 a.m. (0400 GMT) on Thursday morning, according to Palestinian officials.
Ross was due to leave Morocco before mid-day.
